name: Bread & Butter
summary: Lead-intelligence platform with server-side tracking: captures the full visitor journey from the first visit, then enriches, scores and nurtures the moment someone submits an email — verified identities instead of IP-based company guesses.
best_for: marketing and revenue teams that want engaged visitors — people who filled a form or left an email — automatically enriched, scored and nurtured, on a genuinely usable freemium tier
skip_if: you want IP-based company guessing at anonymous visitors — that’s a different tool class (Leadfeeder-style) with a different accuracy and compliance profile — or you run many small sites, where per-website pricing adds up
honest_knock: Two meters to watch: it prices per WEBSITE (multi-site setups multiply the $49) and the AI features run on compute-credit blocks that stack as usage grows. On privacy, refined twice in open dialogue with the vendor (16 Jul 2026, verified against their docs). The anonymous journey IS tracked from the first visit, server-side via their site plugin. So ad-blockers and Safari’s ITP don’t strip it the way they kill client-side scripts — the vendor estimates 30-50% of high-value traffic is lost to client-side blocking. What stays dormant until someone submits an email is identity resolution — the ‘hand-raise’ that connects the captured history to a verified person. You still owe normal GDPR care on enriched data, and the real trade-off is simply this: no IP-based guessing at which company an anonymous visitor works for.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month per website (5,000 lead profiles)
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-20 on breadbutter.io/pricing) Two published plans. Free at $0: unlimited website traffic, 200 stored lead profiles, 30 days of attribution retention, your existing web forms, lead capture and content gating, social logins with your own branding, server-side journey tracking, CSV, Google Sheets and Mailchimp export, Slack alerts, unlimited team members, one-day email response. AI Enabled Pro at $49 a month per website: 5,000 lead profiles, 10-year retention, 3,000 credits a month, three peripheral sub-domains, one-hour email response, plus attribution reporting, journey and event tracking, custom views, real-time email validation, Focused Score AI, deep profile enrichment, Nurture AI messages, the Focused Index, and CRM, Zapier and webhook sync. One add-on: Scale Credits at $89 a month per 10,000 credits, stackable. Profiles beyond 5,000 cost 2 credits each; Intelligence Brief syncs cost 5 credits each; the Intelligence Stream needs an enterprise licence. Pro comes with a 30-day trial, no credit card. The pricing page publishes no annual rate and no enterprise price.

compare_with.name: Leadfeeder
compare_with.why: Leadfeeder guesses the company behind anonymous IPs — useful when it lands, though remote work and VPNs often return an ISP instead; Bread & Butter tracks behaviour server-side from the first visit and resolves identity when a visitor hands over an email. Pick by what your sales team acts on: company guesses or verified people
